description: Per-map, per-current-file override for whether the cached directional lights used with sequencer playback cast shadows. All 276 exported rows set the flag to false.

ID.simple: Row name (native Id, exported as ID, e.g. SQ_CONSOLE_PARAM_140_001).
ID.technical: FName native member and DataTable ImportKeyField; all 276 exported row keys equal their ID values. FindSequencerLightRow (retail 0x143cad0) does not look rows up by name: it iterates every row of every SequencerLightDataTables table (DTM +0xB80) with GetRows in table/row-name order and compares only Id_Map and LevelSequenceFileName against the active map and file. No consumer of the row's Id value or of the row key was found in Source.

Id_Map.simple: Map ID this override applies to.
Id_Map.technical: FName compared with AGameSequencerManager::MapRow->Id; MapRow is the pointer stored by SetMapRow and cleared by ResetSequencer. Both Id_Map and LevelSequenceFileName must match, and GetRows returns the first matching row in table/row-name order across all SequencerLightDataTables tables; no match returns null and no shadow change occurs. The export covers four map IDs (MAP_14, MAP_14_01, MAP_15, MAP_15_01, 69 rows each), all present in MapDataTable; other maps have no row here.

LevelSequenceFileName.simple: Level sequence file name this override applies to.
LevelSequenceFileName.technical: FName compared with FGameSequencerLoadingFileParameter::Filename, not the row ID and not CurrentRequest.SequenceName. The file parameter is found by matching SequenceName to File.ID in LoadingParameter->GetFileParameters(); if MapRow or that file parameter is absent, the finder returns null. The exact (Id_Map, LevelSequenceFileName) pair selects the cinematic. The export has 71 distinct filenames, each repeated once for each of the four maps with no duplicate pair; example: SQ_Appearance_CP_010_CP_040 on MAP_14.

bDirectionalLightCastShadows.simple: Whether the cinematic's registered directional lights should cast shadows.
bDirectionalLightCastShadows.technical: Bool, constructor default false. On sequence start, a found row overwrites ULightComponent::CastShadows on every ALight in the cached SequencerLights array and records the prior bit in LightCastShadows, a TMap keyed by weak ALight pointer. That array is rebuilt by RefreshMapActors from all ADirectionalLight actors in the world, so the name is accurate and the loop covers the whole cache. On stop, a row is found again and each light is restored from its saved bit, or from !bDirectionalLightCastShadows when no saved entry exists (for example, a light registered after start). If another sequence is queued, OnPlayerStop returns before this block, so no restore happens then; the cache is cleared at the next start. All 276 exported values are false, so configured sequences write false and the unsaved-entry fallback is true.

notes: Loader: GameDataTableManager.cpp:487 adds SequencerLightDataTable to the DataTable primary-asset loader batch; line 314 resolves that loader into AGameDataTableManager::SequencerLightDataTables (+0xB80). The catalog lists one variant/shard (276 rows), and the separate JJKJsonEditor input_json copy is byte-identical to the export used here.

The only direct row reader in Source is AGameSequencerManager::FindSequencerLightRow, called from OnSequenceStarting and OnPlayerStop. It is not keyed by row name and is not gated by bKeepLighting. The same SequencerLights cache is read by the sequencer SwitchDirectionalLight track for visibility, but that track does not read this table or its flag.

No other per-sequence light settings (intensity, color, light type) or array/numeric fields exist in the row struct or the export. None of the FNames is empty or 'None' and there is no sentinel value; the only exported bool value is false.

Evidence boundary: the row finder, its GetRows collector, and the row constructor are byte-matched MATCH records; OnSequenceStarting, OnPlayerStop and FindCurrentFileParameter are behavioural reconstructions in status/. No retail Blueprint graph evidence was inspected; AGENTS.md states that the game's Blueprints contain no logic and behaviour is in C++.

usages.detail: Resolves the SequencerLightDataTable primary-asset loader into AGameDataTableManager::SequencerLightDataTables (+0xB80); the name is batched at line 487.
FindSequencerLightRow requires a MapRow and a current file parameter, then returns the first row whose (Id_Map, LevelSequenceFileName) equals (MapRow->Id, File->Filename), or null.
Sequence start clears the saved-bit map and, for a found row, applies bDirectionalLightCastShadows to every cached sequencer directional light while recording its previous CastShadows bit.
A queued next sequence makes OnPlayerStop return before the shadow block, leaving the saved bits until the next start clears them.
Sequence stop, when not skipped for a queued request and when a row is still found, restores each light from LightCastShadows or from the inverted row flag if no saved entry exists.
